name: Cedar Key
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Cedar Key?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on streets the city designates and signs. No current street list for Cedar Key was found, so plain golf carts stay red except a tagged cart path. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Cedar Key?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.
